corrections_addressed.main_review_issue: verify_pins hashed bytes, but public JSON loaders reopened and parsed unchecked bytes; a replacement between pin pass and parse was consumed while the report still claimed the original verified digest.
corrections_addressed.fix: Every public document loader (load_json_document) reads the file once into an immutable byte buffer, verifies sha256 of that exact buffer against the context expected pin, then decodes the same buffer; missing/unreadable/changed inputs produce explicit blocked/failed outcomes and no unverified JSON is consumed. Helper imports hash and compile the same buffer.
corrections_addressed.note: Race regression runs against isolated temporary copies; no product input is mutated by tests.

corrections_addressed.main_review_issue: A missing pin masked an observed hash mismatch (corrupt-available + missing reported blocked 2 instead of failed 1); only one of the two lists was reported.
corrections_addressed.fix: Precedence: any observed corrupt/unreadable/invalid available input must be failed (exit 1); only all-missing prerequisites are blocked (exit 2). Mixed situations report both the missing list and the mismatch details. Explicit --scope force-offline without --archive is a missing prerequisite (blocked 2), while malformed CLI arguments remain usage_error.

corrections_addressed.main_review_issue: VerificationSpec stored caller-owned mutable dicts, and any spec with name production was accepted (dataclasses.replace on a synthetic spec produced a production-labelled PASS over a 1056-byte synthetic archive).
corrections_addressed.fix: All spec containers are immutable copies on ingress (MappingProxyType over dict copies; tuples for sequences), so later caller mutations cannot alter the spec and direct spec-map writes fail. A production-labelled context must exactly match the immutable canonical PRODUCTION_SPEC fields/pins/counts/provenance before any data/helper read, otherwise it is rejected early with deterministic failed exit 1 and no helper execution. Custom contexts are explicitly reported as synthetic_fixture with production_provenance=false; there is no caller-supplied trusted flag.

corrections_addressed.main_review_issue: --output could overwrite a pinned input (main reproduced with --output clone/data/preprocessing.json inside a cloned tree returning exit 0) while the report presented its prior bytes as verified.
corrections_addressed.fix: Before any output probe or write, the resolved/canonicalized output path is compared with all actually-read inputs (the 9 pinned paths, the selected archive, the verifier entrypoint), including equal-path spellings such as .. components and existing-file samefile aliases (hardlink/symlink/junction); a protected target is rejected with failed exit 1 and originals stay byte-identical. Legitimate report paths such as data/manifest.json remain allowed.

corrections_addressed.main_review_issue: The published unit suite required the private controller file verify-data-main-decisions.json and assumed a fixed worktree depth, so an ordinary peer checkout failed FileNotFoundError.
corrections_addressed.fix: The constants test compares pinned identity against literal expected 9 hashes/counts/contract written in the test file itself (from main decisions); no private controller file or .local tree is referenced. Real-archive integration cases are gated by the DEEPEYE_FORCE_ARCHIVE environment path and skip with a counted reason when unset (SkipContractTests enforces exactly 3 gated skips). The CLI default full scope no longer invents a 4-parent archive location: without an explicit --archive it reports archive status no_path (blocked 2) truthfully.

Iteration incident (test-side only): three self-inflicted test-logic errors were found and fixed while iterating the stage suite. (1) The skip-contract test counted occurrences of the skip-reason literal in its own source and the assertion string itself added an extra occurrence (off-by-one); fixed by splitting the literal (tp2i/tp2j). (2) The spec-immutability test asserted production counts after replace(group_counts=...) instead of the caller snapshot (train: 999); corrected to the snapshot semantics plus inequality with PRODUCTION_SPEC (tp2i). (3) The legitimate-output test originally required the real archive and exit 0; rewritten (tp2f) to run without the archive and expect the truthful blocked exit 2 while output_write stays passed, which is checkout-portable. No product-code defect was involved in these three.
